subject_group: 12.2.6 Sufficiency of electrical wiring interconnect system installation

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that wiring design provides for routing and installation to minimize the risk of damage to wiring by cargo, crew and maintenance personnel. Standard: Wiring support complies with good design practice, as defined in SAE AS50881 for aircraft and NFPA 70 for ground stations. Other specification(s) may apply for shipboard and ground mobile applications. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis and inspection. Analysis and inspection of design, including processes, drawings, documents, FMECA and assembled product verify that wiring and its installation are suitably protected. References: For guidance/principles leading toward maintainable design(s): JSSG-2001: 3.1.5, 3.3.10.2.2, 4.1.5, 4.4.8 JSSG-2009: H.6.3.1 SAE AS50881 NFPA 70

Standard: The wiring design provides for routing and installation to avoid damage to wiring IAW SAE AS50881, Routing paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) A wiring design documentation (e.g., schematics, drawings, and models) review verifies wires are routed and installed to avoid damage to wiring IAW SAE AS50881, Routing paragraph.
(2) A physical installation examination through the means of a first article inspection, verification, or quality assurance review verifies wiring routing and installation is IAW SAE AS50881, Routing paragraph.
